parsed.claim_reason: The n+1 parts are distinct powers of 2 (2^0..2^n). Uniqueness of binary representation means each of the 2^{n+1} subsets gives a distinct sum, covering exactly 0 through 2^{n+1}-1.
parsed.witness_reason: For n=2 the parts are 1, 2, 4; there is no part of length 3, so {2,3} is not a subset of the parts. The actual subset sums are 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 — all distinct. No collision exists.
